reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin primarily focused on customizable themes and typography, with an integrated project file and read-only Git workbench, file references, previews, and balance display.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供可定制主题、字体设置以及集成项目文件树、预览和只读 Git 信息的工作台。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides customizable themes and typography together with a project file, preview, and read-only Git workbench.

capabilities: Customizes web interface themes, typography, and panel layouts
Searches and reads files from the current project workspace for references and previews
Displays read-only Git status, diffs, logs, and commit details
Calls the DeepSeek balance endpoint through the host credentials service
Stores display preferences in browser localStorage
